hook: Gemini ab aapka kaam background mein karega. Aur India mein ye free hai.

beats.narration: Gemini ab aapka kaam background mein karega. Aur India mein ye free hai.
Google ne seventeen November ko Tasks free kar diya. India, US, Canada, Australia, Japan aur Korea mein.
beats.claim: Tasks in Gemini is rolling out free in the US, India, Canada, Australia, Japan and Korea (17 Nov 2026).

beats.narration: Matlab aap kaam batao, Gemini peeche lag jaata hai, aur ready hone pe notification bhejta hai.
beats.claim: Tasks works in the background and notifies you when results are ready.

beats.narration: Jaise roz subah email aur calendar ka briefing. Trip ka itinerary. Ya kisi topic pe research.
beats.claim: Examples: daily morning briefings across email and calendar, trip itineraries, automated research.

beats.narration: Ek baar bolo, roz chalega. Recurring routine bhi set ho jaata hai.
Par shopping aur business ko call karne wale features abhi sirf US mein hain. Aur har account pe ek saath nahi aayega, dheere dheere roll out ho raha hai.
beats.claim: Google Pay checkout in Tasks and texting/emailing Gemini roll out to U.S. users; availability arrives in stages.

beats.narration: Gemini app kholo aur Tasks dhoondo. Mila? Comment mein batao.

title: Gemini ab aapka kaam background mein karega, free mein
description: 17 Nov 2026 se Gemini Tasks India mein free users ke liye roll out ho raha hai: morning briefing, trip plan, research. Source: Google Gemini release notes.
